0022600149.text: The Hawks (2-3, 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back) are on a three-game losing streak and have yet to win at home this season, though they are 2-1 on the road, while the Pelicans are winless at 0-4 and have lost four straight. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and New Orleans is missing Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle), and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 117-100 win in Atlanta on January 7.
